description: This file implements the SharedFdGatekeeperChannel class, which manages communication over shared file descriptors for the Gatekeeper service in Android. It includes methods for sending requests and responses, serializing messages, and receiving messages.

classes.name: SharedFdGatekeeperChannel
classes.description: A class that manages communication with the Gatekeeper service over shared file descriptors, providing methods to send requests, responses, and receive messages.

methods.name: SharedFdGatekeeperChannel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the channel with input and output shared file descriptors.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message with a command ID and GateKeeperMessage.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message with a command ID and GateKeeperMessage.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Internal method to serialize and send a message, indicating whether it is a response.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives a message from the channel.
